title: Closed-ball density from the weighted blow-up (Simon Ch. 3, 1.8(2))
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 0, μ a Borel measure on E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} that is finite on compact sets, x ∈ E, P an n-dimensional linear subspace and c > 0 such that t⁻ⁿ∫ f(t⁻¹(y − x)) dμ(y) → c∫_P f dHⁿ as t ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(E, ℝ). Then μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρⁿ) → c as ρ ↓ 0, where B_ρ(x) is the closed ball, μ(B_ρ(x)) is taken as a real number (μ.real) and ω_n = omega n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (c : ℝ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 < c → (∀ f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (c * ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ.real (closedBall x ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 c)
